limits: Proof artifacts are not published product packages or final installers.
Actual receipts distinguish native CLI, rendered browsing, media and installation evidence.
Older Linux compatibility requires an older ABI build and native proof; Ubuntu 22.04/Debian 12 are not qualified by Ubuntu 24.04 output.
Host-local preferences/history may be shared by both editions; recipient state never requires sender state.
Missing Linux dynamic libraries can fail before main; archive prerequisite guidance covers that boundary.
